description: This file defines the 'Coupon' controller class in the OpenCart admin panel for managing marketing coupons. It contains methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting coupons, and viewing their histories. The class extends the core Controller and interacts with models, views, and language files specific to coupon management.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing coupons in OpenCart admin panel, providing CRUD operations, listing, enabling/disabling, deletion, and history viewing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the coupons list page, sets up page title, breadcrumbs, and loads the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of coupons, delegating to getList method.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves coupons from the model with pagination, prepares data for the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the coupon creation/edit form, pre-filling data if editing an existing coupon.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving coupon data, either creating or updating based on provided coupon_id.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history page for a specific coupon.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves coupon usage history with pagination and renders the history view.
